name: BACH_0067
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set, typical input; flagged tier 2 because invasive is top [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1% | Strongly one-sided |
| Conformal set | Invasive only (90% level) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 64th percentile | Typical image |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Invasive | Mostly supportive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 4, 8, 10) · ↑ invasive · Strongest association; above typical here [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Mildly elevated; adds little in concept model · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 1, 4, 5) · ↑ invasive · Small association; do not rely on it · Unreliable
- **Neoplastic nuclei density** (region 6) · context · 1,872 per mm², 87th percentile of reference · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions beats random by 0.54 logit (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown faithful. Necrosis and mitoses are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Component is in situ: nearest InSitu case (BACH_0241) is 88% similar; duct-confined concept Weak (12/20).
- 99% may be overconfident: ECE 0.05 (CI up to 0.18) on 132 test images.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 6**: confirm neoplastic nuclei; assess duct-confined versus invasive growth.
2. **Regions 4, 8, 10**: verify tumor nests infiltrating stroma.
3. **Regions 7, 11**: lowest risk (30%, 79%); check for non-invasive tissue.
